data.title: Binance Will Launch TRX(TRON)  ICO ( BNB Session) Today
data.body:
Dear All,

 

We will launch TRX(TRON) ICO - BNB Session on Binance exchange at 8PM. Aug 23, 2017 (Beijing Time).

The details for TRX ICO session:

  1. Token name: TRX;
  2. ICO ammount of BNB session: 300,000,000 TRX;
  3. Support market: BNB;
  4. Exchange rate: 1 TRX ≈ 0.00052105 BNB ;
  5. ICO time: 8PM. 2017/08/23 - 8PM. 2017/08/30 (Beijing Time);
  6. Sale type: first come first served basis.

Links:

BNB ICO session

ICO Instruction

Website:TRON

Tips:recommend PC participation to get better experience

Risk warning:

ICO investment is subject to high market risk. Please make your investments very cautiously. Binance will chose high quality ICO projects, but will not be responsible for your investment losses.

 

Thank you for your support!

 

Binance Team

August  23, 2017
